messages:
natalie_sales: FYI — DataPulse wants us to onboard an open model called "Helios-Omega-8k" and pin v1 for their pilot. Need EU + ap-south availability, INT4 quant variant, and identical API behavior as hosted. Pilot target in ~3 weeks. Any immediate blockers?
prasad_product: Adding to triage. We need license + model weights link + a small eval set from the customer before we can scope.
lexa_support: Customer says weights are public on HF: https://huggingface.co/helios/omega-8k (v1). License listed as Apache-2.0. They uploaded sample evals too — see S3 link they sent.
alex_eng_ml: Quick notes: we need checkpoint format (safetensors vs pt), tokenizer files, and a small reference output set. INT4 quant may change output distribution—need regen eval. Also we should estimate memory/latency for 8k context.
samantha_ops: Region/residency questions: are they asking for a Private deployment or Hosted availability in ap-south? For hosted we need export-control check for AP-South. Also confirm KMS/AES requirements for Dedicated.
natalie_sales: Pilot is on Hosted first; Dedicated later if pilot goes well. They insisted on AP-South data residency for some logs. I'll ask them to confirm exact residency needs and share the eval prompts.
prasad_product: I'll create an intake ticket (INTAKE-4821) and mark P2 customer pilot. Tentative acceptance criteria: 1) license ok, 2) regressions/safety pass on our eval suite, 3) latency within SLO for common contexts, 4) quantized int4 validated, 5) no export-control blocking.
alex_eng_ml: Proposed minimal catalog entry to start automated checks:
```
model: helios-omega-8k
version: v1
source: hf://helios/omega-8k@v1
weights_format: safetensors or pt
quant_variants: [int4, fp16]
regions: [eu-west-1, ap-south-1]
notes: requires tokenizer and reference outputs for regression tests
```
productops_bot: INTAKE-4821 created and assigned to eng-ml + eng-platform. Initial assessment ETA 5 business days.
leo_security: Quick security ask: confirm provenance of weights (HF link looks ok) and flag to legal if there are redistribution limits. tagging @legal for export control review.
lexa_support: Customer uploaded eval bundle to s3://datapulse-uploads/helios-eval/v1/ — includes 200 prompts + expected outputs.
prasad_product: OK — setting priority P2 and adding to product backlog for upcoming sprint planning. If eng-ml confirms quant path, we can slot a 3-4 week pilot timeline. @alex_eng_ml can you triage kernel/quant support and any special infra needs?
alex_eng_ml: On it. If safetensors exist we can start quant pipelines this week. Note: depending on memory profile we may offer a 4k-context variant as a fallback for Dedicated pools to stay within 24GB GPU constraints.
natalie_sales: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update DataPulse and ask them to confirm residency + any compliance docs. Will follow up once INTAKE-4821 has the assessment.
